narrative: Central Library sends a routine book return notice.

message.body: Dear Student, your borrowed book 'Computer Networks 5th Ed' is due in 3 days. Please return or renew it online via the library catalog before Friday.

evidence.label: Official Library Catalog Portal
evidence.value: Log in at library.college.edu.in shows 'Computer Networks 5th Ed' due in 3 days.

consequence_text.safe: You verified the notice on the official library portal and renewed your book on time.
consequence_text.unsafe: Ignoring or reporting legitimate administrative communications causes missed deadlines and unnecessary friction.

teaching_point: Over-caution check: Legitimate routine notices from official domains should be verified and acted upon.
